bridge_endpoint.description: Upper bound only (476, trailing slash included): CellProtocol opens bridge_endpoint + a UUID bridge ID path component, and BridgeChannelAuthentication.Endpoint limits origin + route to 512 bytes. PortholeContractConsumer.validateNativeBridgeEndpoint is the exact check.

bridge_websocket_url.description: Equal to bridge_endpoint. Carries no contract data: no query, fragment or user info (CellProtocol channel-authenticated endpoints reject them).

contract_presentation_url.description: bridge_endpoint with wss->https (ws->http, loopback only) and '/contract' appended. The client POSTs NativePortholeContractPresentation as a JSON body here before opening the bridge.

cell_endpoint.description: CellProtocol remote cell address cell://<bridge host>/Porthole.
